tasks.subject: Task 1: Scaffold antenna-core; move error.rs + warnings.rs
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A compiling three-member workspace where the shared error/warning vocabulary lives in `antenna-core`, utoipa derives are feature-gated behind an `openapi` feature, and every existing path still resolves.

**Files:**
- Create: `antenna-core/Cargo.toml`, `antenna-core/src/lib.rs`
- Move (git mv): `antenna-model/src/error.rs` -> `antenna-core/src/error.rs`; `antenna-model/src/warnings.rs` -> `antenna-core/src/warnings.rs`
- Modify: `Cargo.toml` (workspace members), `antenna-model/Cargo.toml` (add antenna-core dep with features=["openapi"]), `antenna-model/src/lib.rs` (mod decls -> `pub use antenna_core::{error, warnings};`), `antenna-core/src/warnings.rs` (2 cfg_attr sites, lines ~67 and ~221)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Workspace has three members; `cargo build -p antenna-core` succeeds with and without `--features openapi`
- All existing `antenna_model::` and `crate::` error/warnings paths compile
- Baseline evidence captured in commit message: calibrate's normal dep tree shows 9 poem/h3o/utoipa/dashmap/lru lines before the split
- Default-tier tests and clippy green

**Verify:** `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo nextest run --workspace` -> all green, ~980 tests

**Steps:** Branch refactor/d4-antenna-core-split; capture baseline dep tree; write antenna-core/Cargo.toml (full dep list in plan doc); add workspace member; git mv the two files; write core lib.rs with identical lint header; feature-gate the 2 utoipa derives; rewire antenna-model; verify; commit with baseline in message. Full code in plan doc Task 1.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Move model/, data/{types,loader}.rs, and Position3D into core
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The entire physics engine and the artifact data layer live in `antenna-core`; antenna-model re-exports them at their old paths; the generated OpenAPI spec is byte-identical.

**Files:**
- Move (git mv, ONE commit — loader.rs uses crate::model::PHYSICS_MODEL_VERSION, types.rs uses crate::model::geometry, model uses crate::data): `antenna-model/src/model/` (14 files) -> `antenna-core/src/model/`; `antenna-model/src/data/types.rs` and `data/loader.rs` -> `antenna-core/src/data/`
- Create: `antenna-core/src/data/mod.rs`
- Modify: `antenna-core/src/lib.rs`, `antenna-model/src/lib.rs`, `antenna-model/src/data/mod.rs` (hybrid re-export + repository), `antenna-model/src/api/schemas.rs` (cut CoordinateSystem ~32-41 + Position3D struct/impl ~108+; add re-export), `antenna-core/src/model/coordinates_3d.rs` (receive both types, cfg_attr utoipa derives, add serde import), `antenna-core/src/model/pattern.rs` (2 doc links ~37/74 to crate::service become plain text), doctest paths sed antenna_model:: -> antenna_core:: (pattern, illumination, integration, loader)

Mechanical compile-fixes in-scope; STOP only if a test VALUE changes or a bug falls out (file it, no drive-by fixes).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- crate::model/data/error/warnings resolve within core unedited
- antenna_model::model/data/api::schemas::Position3D old paths resolve
- `grep -rn 'crate::service\|crate::api\|crate::config' antenna-core/src` -> no hits
- openapi_spec byte-equality test passes
- `cargo test --doc --workspace` passes
- Default-tier tests + clippy green; no test value changed

**Verify:** `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo nextest run --workspace && cargo nextest run -p antenna-model -E 'binary(openapi_spec)' && cargo test --doc --workspace` -> all green

**Steps:** Full code blocks in plan doc Task 2.

tasks.subject: Task 3: Repoint calibrate at antenna-core; prune dead deps
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `calibrate`'s production dependency graph contains no poem/h3o/utoipa/dashmap/lru; the service-serving e2e tests keep running via a dev-dependency; dead deps leave antenna-model.

**Files:**
- Modify: `calibrate/Cargo.toml` — dep swap to antenna-core; antenna-model to [dev-dependencies] (e2e tests serve through the real service path — what caught C13)
- Modify (sed antenna_model:: -> antenna_core::), 10 files: calibrate/src/{antenna_config,artifact_export,bin/cr159703_grid,boresight_calibration,correction_surface,design_specs_loader,frequency_correction,main,parameter_tuner,sidecar}.rs
- Modify: `antenna-model/Cargo.toml` — remove ndarray (confirmed dead); remove num-complex/rayon/crc32fast iff grep-confirmed unused; KEEP postcard (repository.rs uses it)
- Delete: `calibrate/src/mod.rs` (orphan, sanctioned by roadmap hygiene note)
- NOT modified: `calibrate/tests/**` (work via dev-dependency unchanged)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `cargo tree -p calibrate -e normal | grep -E 'poem|h3o|utoipa|dashmap|lru'` -> empty (baseline 9 lines); tokio remains legitimately (calibrate's own aws-sdk dep)
- `cargo tree -p antenna-core -e normal | grep -E 'poem|h3o|tokio|utoipa'` -> empty
- Dead deps pruned grep-verified; orphan mod.rs deleted; no antenna_model code refs in calibrate/src
- Full-tier suite green

**Verify:** `cargo tree -p calibrate -e normal | grep -cE 'poem|h3o|utoipa|dashmap|lru'` -> 0, then `RUST_MIN_STACK=16777216 cargo nextest run --workspace --profile full && cargo test --doc --workspace` -> all green

**Steps:** Full commands in plan doc Task 3. Commit records the 9->0 measurement.
